basic_info.description: Located in one of San Francisco's most coveted residential enclaves of Sutro Heights, 511 47th Avenue presents a rare opportunity to refresh a classic home and live near the city's western edgejust moments from Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, and the vibrant Outer Richmond corridor.  Spanning 1,880 square feet, this spacious residence offers an exceptional floor plan with two well-proportioned bedrooms, a versatile den ideal for a home office or guest room, and one-and-a-half bathrooms. The interior is rich with natural light, high ceilings, and classic architectural detailing that nods to the home's timeless charm.  Perfect for those who appreciate both proximity to nature and city convenience, this location is a true standoutwalkable to trails, museums, local cafes, and beloved neighborhood markets, all while offering a peaceful residential setting.  Whether you're seeking a full-time home or a serene city retreat by the coast, 511 47th Avenue is an extraordinary opportunity to reimagine a classic and experience coastal San Francisco living at its best.
